limitations: All T-LESS 1-30 V3 outputs existed before this protocol was frozen.
The six test objects provide object-level generalization evidence but are not a pristine external benchmark.
A second dataset or new real-camera captures are required for a genuinely blind final validation.
The split is stratified by configured symmetry type, not by unverified visual-family labels.
